name: LiteLLM
scope_notes: Covers LiteLLM Proxy (AI Gateway). Self-hosted open-source proxy (MIT) with an Enterprise license gating JWT auth, IP filtering, audit logs and key rotation; all controls are operator config on your own deployment.

controls.name: key/block
controls.what: Blocks a virtual key; /key/unblock re-enables it.

controls.name: key/delete
controls.what: Deletes a virtual key; deletion is recorded in audit logs and the Deleted Keys view.

controls.name: key_generation_settings
controls.what: Limits which user or team roles may create personal or team keys, and can require params.

controls.name: upperbound_key_generate_params
controls.what: Rejects key requests above a max duration, budget or rate limit.

controls.name: custom_key_policy
controls.what: Custom Python hook that can deny any key create, update or regenerate (e.g. require expiry within 7 days).

controls.name: allowed_routes
controls.what: Restricts which proxy routes a key can call, including admin-owned keys.

controls.name: team_member_permissions
controls.what: Controls which key-management routes team members may call; default is read-only key info.

controls.name: allowed_ips
controls.what: Only listed client IPs can call proxy endpoints; others get 403.

controls.name: Key regenerate (rotation)
controls.what: Issues a new secret; old secret is revoked immediately unless a grace_period is set.

controls.name: Scheduled key rotation (auto_rotate)
controls.what: Background job regenerates keys on rotation_interval and invalidates the old string.

controls.name: disable_env_credential_login
controls.what: Stops the master key and UI_USERNAME/UI_PASSWORD from logging into the Admin UI; API use of the master key continues.

controls.name: Master key rotation
controls.what: Replace the master key value and restart every proxy instance.
controls.setting: LITELLM_MASTER_KEY / general_settings.master_key; POST /key/regenerate with new_master_key when no salt key

controls.name: SCIM user deprovisioning
controls.what: Deprovisioning a user blocks all keys they own and clears them from the auth cache.

controls.name: JWT audience/issuer validation
controls.what: JWT_AUDIENCE/JWT_ISSUER or litellm_jwtauth.issuers restrict which tokens are accepted; unset means any token from listed providers is accepted.

controls.name: store_audit_logs
controls.what: Records create/update/delete/regenerate of keys, teams, users, models.

controls.name: enable_jwt_auth
controls.what: JWT tokens are only checked when this config setting is on; leaving it unset means JWT auth is not accepted.

no_control.what: Failed-login rate limiting does not cover use of the master key as an API bearer token.
Disabling env-credential UI login does not stop the master key on the API.

controls_unknown: Whether /key/delete and /key/block take effect instantly or after an auth-cache TTL (only SCIM deprovisioning is documented as clearing the cache).
Master key expiry and SCIM token expiry, rotation and revocation steps.
Whether management GET calls (/key/info, /key/list, /spend/logs) are logged anywhere besides server logs.

authentication.summary: A single static bearer secret set in config or env. It is the proxy admin credential: it calls admin APIs, mints other keys, and by default also logs into the Admin UI.

federation.details: Static shared secret; SSO covers only the Admin UI and the master key keeps working on the API.

ip_restriction.boundary: general_settings.allowed_ips restricts which IPs can call any proxy endpoint (Enterprise). Not per-key.

lifetime.summary: No expiry documented; valid until changed and proxy restarted

renewal.summary: Set a new value in env/config and restart all instances (or POST /key/regenerate with new_master_key when no salt key).

administration.summary: Whoever controls the proxy environment controls the master key. disable_env_credential_login stops it working on the UI login page but not on the API.

sso.details: disable_env_credential_login only stops master-key login on the Admin UI page; the master key keeps authenticating admin API calls and is the documented recovery path when UI login is locked down.

offboard.details: Single deployment-wide secret set in config/env, not tied to a user.

reads.ui: Admin UI > Logs (filter by key alias)

token_format.notes: Master key must start with sk-; generated keys are returned as sk-... and stored hashed.

log_sources.name: Audit Logs (LiteLLM_AuditLog)
log_sources.notes: Enterprise; on by default with license, else store_audit_logs: true. UI Logs -> Audit Logs; export via audit_log_callbacks (e.g. S3). Retention is your DB.

log_sources.name: Spend logs (LiteLLM_SpendLogs)
log_sources.notes: Per-request rows with key hash; no prompt content by default; can be disabled; retention via maximum_spend_logs_retention_period.

lifecycle_events.notes: Also shown in Deleted Keys view

anomaly_cues: Any admin action attributed to the master key
UI logins with env credentials (banner shown while enabled)

containment.steps: POST /key/block or /key/delete; for master key, change LITELLM_MASTER_KEY and restart all instances.
containment.notes: Restart loads the new value; old value no longer matches.

calls.log_notes: Not in audit log action list (create/update/delete/regenerate)
Admin-owned keys can call management routes

calls.reveals: Request logs; prompts only if store_prompts_in_spend_logs

authentication.summary: sk- bearer keys created via /key/generate or the Admin UI, optionally owned by a user and/or team. Management-route rights follow the owning user's role, so an admin-owned key can call admin endpoints.

federation.details: Static keys; SSO is for the Admin UI only. JWT auth is the documented alternative to long-lived keys.

ip_restriction.boundary: Only the proxy-wide allowed_ips list (Enterprise); no per-key IP list documented.

lifetime.summary: Optional duration per key; can be 'Never expires'; admins can cap via upperbound_key_generate_params or custom_key_policy

renewal.summary: POST /key/{key}/regenerate (Enterprise) issues a new secret; old one revoked immediately unless grace_period; optional scheduled auto_rotate.

administration.summary: Admins can restrict who creates keys (key_generation_settings), limit models/routes/budgets per key, block/unblock, delete, and enforce policy hooks.
administration.conditions: Rotation and audit logs need Enterprise.

offboard.details: User-only keys are deleted when the user is deleted, and SCIM deprovisioning blocks the user's keys and clears them from the auth cache. Team service-account keys persist (see litellm-3).

inventory.details: Admin UI Virtual Keys page / GET /key/list; the proxy_admin_viewer role can view all keys.

reads.ui: Admin UI > Logs (filter by key alias)

offboard.api: POST /user/delete {"user_ids": [...]} (deletes user-only keys); SCIM: PATCH/PUT /scim/v2/Users/{id} active=false or DELETE /scim/v2/Users/{id} (blocks keys)

containment.steps: POST /key/block or /key/delete; for master key, change LITELLM_MASTER_KEY and restart all instances.
containment.notes: Block/delete is immediate on the worker that handles it. Without Redis, other workers keep accepting the key until their cache entry expires (user_api_key_cache_ttl, default 60 s). SCIM deprovisioning is documented as immediate.

credentials.name: OIDC / JWT-based auth (incl. Kubernetes ServiceAccount tokens)

authentication.summary: With enable_jwt_auth, the proxy accepts IdP-signed JWTs as bearer tokens, validated against configured JWKS URLs; claims map to users, teams and admin scope.

federation.details: Any OIDC issuer with JWKS, including Kubernetes service account tokens. Audience/issuer checks are optional unless configured.

lifetime.summary: Set by the IdP via exp; proxy checks exp

renewal.summary: Client obtains a new JWT from its IdP.

administration.summary: Configured in config.yaml (enable_jwt_auth, JWT_PUBLIC_KEY_URL, JWT_AUDIENCE, litellm_jwtauth.issuers).

sso.details: Tokens are issued by the operator's own OpenID provider, so IdP policy applies at issuance; LiteLLM only verifies signature and claims at use.

sso.ui: config.yaml general_settings: enable_jwt_auth: true; env JWT_PUBLIC_KEY_URL=<IdP JWKS URL>, JWT_AUDIENCE; or litellm_jwtauth.issuers per issuer. IdP MFA/SSO policy applies at token issuance.

expiry.ui: Set token lifetime at the OpenID provider (exp claim); proxy verifies exp on every request

kill.ui: Remove the issuer from JWT_PUBLIC_KEY_URL / litellm_jwtauth.issuers in config, or rotate IdP signing keys; restart the proxy or wait public_key_ttl (default 600s)

log_sources.name: Audit Logs (LiteLLM_AuditLog)
log_sources.notes: Enterprise; on by default with license, else store_audit_logs: true. UI Logs -> Audit Logs; export via audit_log_callbacks (e.g. S3). Retention is your DB.

log_sources.name: Spend logs (LiteLLM_SpendLogs)
log_sources.notes: Per-request rows with key hash; no prompt content by default; can be disabled; retention via maximum_spend_logs_retention_period.

anomaly_cues: Tokens from unexpected issuer when JWT_AUDIENCE/JWT_ISSUER unset

containment.steps: Revoke at the IdP, remove the issuer/JWKS URL from config, or rotate signing keys.
containment.notes: Issued JWTs remain valid until exp unless the issuer is removed; JWKS cached for public_key_ttl.

unknown: Exact log fields for JWT-authenticated requests

calls.reveals: Mint a virtual key with the JWT (shown in docs)

authentication.summary: Bearer token created under Settings > Admin Settings > SCIM, used by the IdP to call /scim endpoints.

federation.details: Static token held by the IdP.

ip_restriction.boundary: allowed_ips applies to proxy endpoints; /scim/v2 routes use the same user_api_key_auth path that runs the IP check (from source). Docs do not name /scim routes explicitly. Enterprise.

renewal.summary: Create a new token in the UI; rotation/revocation steps not documented.

administration.summary: Created by admins in the Admin UI; can deprovision users, which blocks their keys.

offboard.details: Token is created for the IdP provisioning connection, not a person.
